Gol raaste mein electron ghoom kar PS I par hi laut aaya, aur sirf ATP bana.
Dono raaston mein ATP bana, par kaise bana, yeh humne abhi tak nahi dekha.

teacher_lines.roman: Toh ATP bana kaise?
ATP bana kaise, yahi aaj ka sawaal hai: chloroplast mein ATP asal mein banta kaise hai.
Aksar hum sochte hain ki electron daudte-daudte khud ATP bana deta hai.
Bahut saalon tak vaigyanik bhi kuch aisa hi maante the: ki electron ki daud aur ATP ke beech koi seedha rasayanik jod hai.
1961 mein Peter Mitchell naam ke vaigyanik ne ek naya vichaar diya.
Baad mein prayogon ne use sahi saabit kiya, aur iske liye unhe 1978 mein Nobel puraskaar mila.
Kisi baat ko samjhane ke liye diya gaya aisa vichaar, jise prayogon se parkha jaata hai, hypothesis kehlata hai.
Mitchell ke vichaar ka naam hai chemiosmotic hypothesis.
Naam ko todo toh poora vichaar samajh aa jaata hai.
Chemi yaani rasayanik kaam, yahan ATP banana.
Osmotic, jaise class 9 ka osmosis, yaani membrane ke aar-paar kisi cheez ka bahna; yahan H⁺ ka.
Toh naam hi keh raha hai: membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ bahenge, aur us bahav se ATP banega.
Pehle jagah pakki kar lo.
Chloroplast ke andar chapti-chapti thailiyan hoti hain, jinhe thylakoid kehte hain; inke dher ko grana kehte hain.
Har thaili ki deewar thylakoid membrane hai.
Thaili ke andar ki band jagah lumen hai, aur thaili ke bahar, chloroplast ka gaadha dravya, stroma hai.
Socho paani se bhara ek balloon, jo paani ki baalti mein tair raha hai: balloon ki rubber membrane hai, balloon ke andar ka paani lumen hai, aur baalti ka paani stroma.
Is poori film mein andar ka matlab lumen, aur bahar ka matlab stroma.
PS II, PS I aur electron carriers isi membrane mein, ya uske theek paas, baithe hain.
Ab H⁺ ko pehchano.
Hydrogen ke atom mein ek proton aur ek electron hota hai.
Electron nikal jaaye, toh bachta hai sirf ek proton, jis par positive charge hai.
Isliye H⁺ ko hydrogen ion bhi kehte hain aur proton bhi; teeno naam ek hi cheez ke hain.
Class 9 mein aapne padha tha: koi cheez jahan zyada hoti hai, wahan se apne-aap kam wali jagah ki taraf failti hai, jaise kamre mein agarbatti ki khushboo.
Yeh dhalaan jaisa hai: gend dhalaan par apne-aap neeche ludhakti hai, par upar chadhaane mein zor lagta hai.
Membrane ke ek taraf H⁺ zyada aur doosri taraf kam hon, toh H⁺ ki is dhalaan ko proton gradient kehte hain; gradient ka matlab hi dhalaan hai.
ATP banna isi dhalaan ke banne se juda hai: pehle dhalaan banti hai, phir H⁺ dhalaan se neeche bahte hain, aur us bahav se ATP banta hai.
Dhalaan nahi, toh ATP nahi.
Bilkul baandh ki tarah: pehle paani ek taraf roka jaata hai, aur chhodne par usi se bijli banti hai.
Chloroplast mein yeh H⁺ thaili ke andar, yaani lumen mein, jama hote hain: andar zyada, bahar stroma mein kam.
Yahi tareeka aap aage respiration wale chapter mein mitochondria mein bhi padhoge.
Jeevon mein ATP banane ka yeh sabse aam tareeka hai.
Mitochondria ki do membranes hoti hain, ek bahar wali aur ek andar wali.
Andar wali membrane mein bhi electron carriers ki ek kadi hoti hai, jise electron transport system, yaani ETS, kehte hain.
Wahan jab electron ETS mein daudte hain, toh H⁺ dono membranes ke beech ki patli jagah mein jama hote hain.
Is jagah ko intermembrane space kehte hain.
Toh batao, chloroplast mein H⁺ kahan jama hote hain, aur mitochondria mein kahan?
Chloroplast mein H⁺ thylakoid ke andar, lumen mein, jama hote hain; mitochondria mein do membranes ke beech, intermembrane space mein.
Tareeka ek, jagah alag; yeh farq exam ke liye pakka yaad rakho.

teacher_lines.roman: Ab agla sawaal: yeh dhalaan banti kaise hai?

teacher_lines.roman: H⁺ ko andar bharta kaun hai?
H⁺ ko andar kaun bharta hai, iska jawab usi raaste mein chhupa hai jo hum pehle padh chuke hain: electron ka jaagna aur aage badhna.
Isliye wahi raasta ek baar phir chalenge, par is baar nazar H⁺ par rakhenge.

Electron ka jaagna, yaani activation of electrons, aap jaante ho: roshni PS II ke reaction centre P680 aur PS I ke reaction centre P700 par padti hai, aur unka electron energy lekar upar uchhalta hai.
Uchhle electron ko sabse pehle primary acceptor pakadta hai.
Phir woh electron carriers ki kadi mein ek se doosre tak aage badhta hai; yahi electron ka transport hai.
Ab Figure 11.7 dekho; ise saath-saath padhenge.
Beech mein thylakoid ki band membrane hai.
Andar ki jagah par likha hai lumen, high H⁺; bahar likha hai stroma, low H⁺.
Yaani andar H⁺ zyada, bahar kam.
Membrane mein PS II aur PS I baithe hain, aur dono par roshni ke teer pad rahe hain: P680 par aur P700 par.
PS II ke paas, andar ki taraf, paani toot raha hai.
Wahan ½O₂ likha hai, kyunki paani ke ek molecule se aadha O₂ molecule milta hai; do molecule milkar ek poora O₂ dete hain.
Ab electron ke raaste par ungli rakh kar chalo: PS II se PQ, yaani plastoquinone; phir cytochrome b6f; phir PC, yaani plastocyanin; phir PS I.
PS I ke baad electron Fd, yaani ferredoxin, ke paas jaata hai, aur phir NADP reductase NADP⁺ se NADPH banata hai.
Yeh wahi Z scheme ka raasta hai jo humne pehle padha tha.
Ab H⁺ ke teer dekho: kuch teer stroma se uthkar andar lumen mein jaate hain, aur saare teer lumen mein hi jama hote dikhte hain.
Figure mein ek machine bhi hai, jiska ek hissa membrane mein dhansa hai aur ek bahar nikla hai.
Lumen ke H⁺ isi se bahar stroma mein lautte hain, aur wahin ADP + Pᵢ se ATP banta dikhaya hai.
Is machine ko hum thodi der mein kholenge.
Aur ek tikona nishaan hai, jo andar high se bahar low ki taraf patla hota jaata hai; uspar likha hai electrochemical potential gradient.
Electrochemical isliye, kyunki dhalaan do cheezon ki hai.
Chemical yaani ginti: andar H⁺ zyada.
Electro yaani charge: H⁺ positive hain, toh andar positive charge bhi zyada.
Dono milkar H⁺ ko andar se bahar ki taraf dhakelte hain.
Is poore raaste mein teen jagah H⁺ ka hisaab badalta hai.
Yahi teen kaam humein dhoondhne hain: paani ka tootna, PQ ka H⁺ dhona, aur NADPH ka banna.

teacher_lines.roman: Paani PS II ke paas toot-ta hai, aur yeh jagah membrane ke andar wale chehre par hai, yaani lumen ki taraf.
Pichhli film mein humne dekha tha: paani ke do molecule toot kar chaar electron, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ dete hain.
Tootna andar ki taraf hota hai, isliye yeh chaar H⁺, yaani protons ya hydrogen ions, bahar nahi jaate.
Woh seedhe lumen mein hi chhoot jaate hain.
Baandh ki jheel socho, jiske andar hi ek sota phoot pada ho.
Paani bahar se laana hi nahi pada, jheel apne-aap bhar rahi hai.
Toh pehla kaam yeh hua: paani ke tootne se lumen mein H⁺ badhe.
Doosra kaam electron ke raaste mein chhupa hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Ise dekhne ke liye aapko do tarah ke carriers ka farq samajhna hoga.
Kuch carriers sirf electron uthate hain, aur use aage de dete hain.
Inhe electron carrier kehte hain.
Kuch carriers electron ke saath ek H⁺ bhi utha lete hain.
Inhe H carrier kehte hain, yaani hydrogen carrier.
Aapko yaad hoga ki ek proton aur ek electron milkar hydrogen ka atom banate hain.
Isliye H carrier asal mein poora hydrogen dhota hai.
Ab electron ka raasta dhyan se dekho.
PS II se uchhla electron sabse pehle primary acceptor pakadta hai.
Yeh acceptor membrane ke bahar wale chehre ki taraf, yaani stroma ki taraf, baitha hai.
Yeh acceptor electron kisi electron carrier ko nahi deta.
Woh use ek H carrier ko deta hai.
H carrier ko electron ke saath H⁺ bhi chahiye, aur woh bahar wale chehre par hai.
Isliye electron lete waqt woh bahar stroma se ek H⁺ bhi utha leta hai.
Figure 11.7 mein yeh H carrier PQ hai, yaani plastoquinone.
H⁺ uthane ke baad ise PQH₂ likhte hain.
PQ ek chhota molecule hai.
Woh membrane ke andar hi tairta hua bahar wale chehre se andar wale chehre tak chala jaata hai.
Andar wale chehre par woh apna electron ek electron carrier ko de deta hai; figure mein yeh cytochrome b6f hai.
Aur electron dete hi PQ saath laaya H⁺ lumen mein chhod deta hai.
Baandh mein socho, ek pump neeche ki nadi se paani uthakar jheel mein daal raha hai.
PQ yahi kaam H⁺ ke saath karta hai.
Ab aap batao, is ek kaam se dono taraf ka farq kaise badla?
Is ek kaam se farq do taraf se badla: bahar stroma mein ek H⁺ kam hua, aur andar lumen mein wahi H⁺ badh gaya.
Toh doosra kaam yeh hua: H carrier H⁺ ko bahar se uthakar andar chhodta hai.

Fd use aage ek enzyme tak pahunchata hai.
Yeh enzyme NADP reductase hai, aur yeh membrane ke bahar, stroma wale chehre par baitha hai.
Figure mein ise FNR likha hai.
Yaad karo, electron lena reduction kehlata hai.
NADP⁺ electron lekar NADPH banta hai, isliye yeh NADP⁺ ka reduction hai.
Is reduction ke liye sirf electron kaafi nahi.
Saath mein H⁺ bhi chahiye, aur yeh H⁺ paas ke stroma se hi liye jaate hain.
Toh socho, kya yeh H⁺ andar lumen mein pahunche?
Yeh H⁺ andar lumen mein nahi pahunche.
Yeh NADPH mein judkar wahin bahar kharch ho gaye.
Phir bhi farq badha, kyunki bahar se H⁺ kam hue.
Andar utne hi rahe aur bahar kam ho gaye, toh dhalaan aur oonchi hui.

Stroma se H⁺ do raaston se gaye: PQ ne uthaaye, aur NADPH ne kharch kiye.
Isliye chloroplast mein stroma ke H⁺ ghatte jaate hain, aur lumen mein H⁺ jama hote jaate hain.
Thylakoid membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ka yahi farq proton gradient hai.
Baandh ke peeche jheel bharti ja rahi hai, aur aage ki nadi utarti ja rahi hai.
Ab pH yaad karo.
Kisi ghol mein H⁺ jitne zyada, woh utna acidic, aur uska pH utna kam.
Toh batao, H⁺ bharne par lumen ka pH badhega ya ghatega?
H⁺ bharne par lumen ka pH ghatega.
Aur yeh itna ghatta hai ki ise naapa ja sakta hai.
Roshni mein lumen ka pH lagbhag 5 tak aa jaata hai, jabki stroma lagbhag 8 par rehta hai.
pH ka har ek ank das guna H⁺ ka farq hai.
Toh teen ank ka farq matlab andar H⁺ bahar se lagbhag hazaar guna.
Exam ke liye yaad rakho: lumen acidic hota hai, aur stroma mein H⁺ kam hote hain.

Bijli tab banti hai, jab paani neeche bahta hai.
Waise hi lumen mein H⁺ ka jama rehna ATP nahi banata.
ATP tab banta hai jab H⁺ wapas bahar stroma mein bahte hain.
H⁺ ke wapas bahne se dono taraf ka farq ghatta hai.
Isi ko gradient ka tootna kehte hain, yaani breakdown of this gradient.
Aksar hum sochte hain ki gradient tootne ka matlab H⁺ ka khatam hona hai.
Par aisa nahi hai: H⁺ wahi rehte hain, bas andar aur bahar ka farq kam hota hai.
Par H⁺ membrane mein se aise hi nahi nikal sakte.
Membrane unke liye ek band deewar hai.
Unhe ek khaas raasta chahiye, jo membrane ke aar-paar jaata ho.
Aise raaste ko transmembrane channel kehte hain; trans yaani aar-paar.
Yeh raasta ek bade enzyme ka hissa hai.
Chalo, ab is enzyme ko kholte hain.
Baandh mein paani ek pipe se nikalta hai, aur pipe ke muh par turbine lagi hoti hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Thylakoid membrane mein bhi aisi ek machine lagi hai.
Iska naam ATP synthase hai.
Synthase yaani banane wala enzyme.
Toh ATP synthase, yaani ATP banane wala enzyme.
Iske do hisse hain.
Pehla hissa membrane ke andar dhansa hua hai, aur aar-paar ek channel banata hai.
Ise CF₀ kehte hain.
Doosra hissa membrane se bahar, stroma ki taraf, nikla hua hai.
Ise CF₁ kehte hain.
Aap aise samjho: CF₀ pipe hai, aur CF₁ uske muh par lagi turbine.
H⁺ CF₀ se apne-aap bahte hain, kyunki andar zyada hain aur bahar kam.
Protein unhe dhakelta nahi, bas raasta deta hai.
Zyada se kam ki taraf apne-aap failne ko diffusion kehte hain, jaise humne agarbatti ki khushboo mein dekha tha.
Jab yeh failna kisi protein ke raaste, uski madad se ho, toh use facilitated diffusion kehte hain.
Facilitated yaani madad se.
Toh socho, ATP kis hisse mein banega, andar dhanse CF₀ mein ya bahar nikle CF₁ mein?
ATP bahar wale CF₁ mein banega.
Isliye bana hua ATP seedhe stroma mein milta hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Yeh energy gradient ke tootne se aati hai.
Bahte H⁺ CF₁ ki shakal badal dete hain.
Socho CF₁ ek mutthi hai.
Mutthi khuli, toh ADP aur Pᵢ andar aaye.
Mutthi bheench gayi, toh dono dabkar jud gaye, aur ATP ban gaya.
Mutthi phir khuli, aur ATP bahar.
Mutthi bheenchne ki taakat H⁺ ke bahav se aati hai.
Isliye bahav ruka, toh ATP banna bhi ruka.
Protein ki shakal ke is badlaav ko conformational change kehte hain.
Conformation ka matlab hi shakal hai.
Aur yeh mutthi ek baar nahi, baar-baar khulti aur band hoti hai.
Isliye ek enzyme bahut saare ATP bana deta hai.
Toh ab batao, electron ki daud aur ATP ke beech ki chhupi kadi kya nikli?
Electron ki daud aur ATP ke beech ki chhupi kadi H⁺ ka farq nikli.
Electron ki daud farq banati hai, aur farq ke tootne se ATP banta hai.
Ab poori kahani ek saath chalate hain, aur dekhte hain ki energy kahan se kahan gayi.

teacher_lines.roman: Roshni ki energy ne electron ko uchhala.
Daudte electron ki energy se PQ ne H⁺ ko bahar se andar bhara.
Paani ke tootne ne bhi andar H⁺ chhode.
Isse lumen mein H⁺ ki oonchi dhalaan bani, aur energy ab is dhalaan mein band hai.
Phir H⁺ CF₀ se wapas bahar bahe, aur us bahav ki energy se CF₁ ne ATP banaya.
Energy lagakar H⁺ ko membrane ke paar bharne wale ko proton pump kehte hain.
Yahan yeh kaam electron ki kadi PQ ke saath karti hai.
Membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke is bahav se ATP banne ke poore tareeke ko chemiosmosis kehte hain.
Toh aap batao, chemiosmosis ke liye kaun-kaun si cheezein chahiye?
Chemiosmosis ke liye chaar cheezein chahiye: membrane, proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase.
Baandh mein bhi yahi chaar hain: deewar, pump, ruka hua paani aur turbine.
Exam ke liye teen baatein pakki rakho: H⁺ lumen mein jama hote hain, lumen ka pH ghatta hai, aur ATP CF₁ par stroma ki taraf banta hai.
Ab stroma ke paas do cheezein taiyaar hain: ATP, yaani energy, aur NADPH, yaani electron dene ki taakat.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Stroma mein ATP aur NADPH; hawa ki CO₂ pakadti reaction aur bani sugar; bio aur synthetic shabd ke hisse; CO₂ ka carbon ek molecule mein judta.

teacher_lines.roman: Dono stroma ki taraf hi bane, isliye wahin turant kaam aate hain.
Stroma mein inse ek reaction chalti hai, jo hawa ki CO₂ pakadti hai aur sugar banati hai.
Aisi reaction ko biosynthetic reaction kehte hain.
Bio yaani jeevan, synthetic yaani jodkar banana: jeev ke andar chhote molecule jodkar bade molecule banana.
CO₂ ke carbon ko pakadkar ek molecule mein jod lena CO₂ ko fix karna kehlata hai, yaani fixing CO₂.
Yeh sugar kaise banti hai, yeh hum agli film mein dekhenge.
Abhi ke liye bas itna jaan lo ki light reaction ke ATP aur NADPH yahin kaam aate hain.
